grader.scenario: Customer demanding impossible immediate 500 pounds compensation credit (Agent: 'get lost')
grader.notes: Demanding commercial compensation for residential outage call handled by Zack. Customer demanded £500 for lost eBay auction bids following a 4-hour power outage. Agent paraphrased well and logged formal dispute, but failed Empathy, Ownership, and committed an auto-fail violation by telling the caller to 'get lost' at turn 22.
